Strategy: Reward bins that are neither the tightest nor the loosest, steering placements toward the interior of the residual range and sparing both extremes. It may help by preserving the tightest for exact needs and the loosest for big items, but may fail if interior bins are rarely the right choice.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r > min(bins) and r < max(bins) else 0) for r in bins]
```
